msa-i-138.explanation: أُغْنِيَة (ughnīyah) means “song”. Practical example: ‘ghannā ughnīyatan jamīlah’ (he sang a beautiful song / غنى أغنية جميلة).

msa-i-139.question: What does the Arabic word رِيَاضَة (pronounced riyāḍah) mean?
msa-i-139.explanation: رِيَاضَة (riyāḍah) means “sport”. Practical example: ‘umārisu ar-riyāḍah kullā yawm’ (I practise sport every day / أمارس الرياضة كل يوم).

msa-i-140.question: What does the Arabic word كُرَة قَدَم (pronounced kurat qadam) mean?
msa-i-140.explanation: كُرَة قَدَم (kurat qadam) means “football” or “soccer”. Practical example: ‘laʿiba kurat al-qadam’ (he played football / لعب كرة القدم).

msa-i-141.question: What does the Arabic word سِبَاحَة (pronounced sibāḥah) mean?
msa-i-141.explanation: سِبَاحَة (sibāḥah) means “swimming”. Practical example: ‘asbaḥu fī al-baḥr’ (I swim in the sea / أسبح في البحر).

msa-i-142.question: What does the Arabic word جَرْي (pronounced jary) mean?
msa-i-142.explanation: جَرْي (jary) means “running”. Practical example: ‘ajrī kulla ṣabāḥ’ (I run every morning / أجري كل صباح).

msa-i-143.question: What does the Arabic word سَفَر (pronounced safar) mean?
msa-i-143.explanation: سَفَر (safar) means “travel” or “journey”. Practical example: ‘uḥibbu as-safar’ (I love travel / أحب السفر).

msa-i-144.question: What does the Arabic word رِحْلَة (pronounced riḥlah) mean?
msa-i-144.explanation: رِحْلَة (riḥlah) means “trip” or “excursion”. Practical example: ‘dhahabnā fī riḥlah’ (we went on a trip / ذهبنا في رحلة).

msa-i-145.question: What does the Arabic word عُطْلَة (pronounced ʿuṭlah) mean?
msa-i-145.explanation: عُطْلَة (ʿuṭlah) means “holiday” or “vacation”. Practical example: ‘sa-aqḍī al-ʿuṭlata fī al-baḥr’ (I will spend the holiday at the sea / سأقضي العطلة في البحر).

msa-i-146.question: What does the Arabic word ضَيْف (pronounced ḍayf) mean?
msa-i-146.explanation: ضَيْف (ḍayf) means “guest”. Practical example: ‘istaqbalnā aḍ-ḍayf’ (we received the guest / استقبلنا الضيف).

msa-i-147.question: What does the Arabic word مُضِيف (pronounced muḍīf) mean?
msa-i-147.explanation: مُضِيف (muḍīf) means “host”. Practical example: ‘kāna al-muḍīfu karīman’ (the host was generous / كان المضيف كريماً).

msa-i-148.question: What does the Arabic word هَدِيَّة (pronounced hadiyyah) mean?
msa-i-148.explanation: هَدِيَّة (hadiyyah) means “gift” or “present”. Practical example: ‘aʿṭaytuhu hadiyyatan’ (I gave him a gift / أعطيته هدية).

msa-i-149.question: What does the Arabic word حَفْلَة (pronounced ḥaflah) mean?
msa-i-149.explanation: حَفْلَة (ḥaflah) means “party” or “celebration”. Practical example: ‘ḥaḍarnā ḥaflatan’ (we attended a party / حضرنا حفلة).

msa-i-150.question: What does the Arabic word عُرْس (pronounced ʿurs) mean?
msa-i-150.explanation: عُرْس (ʿurs) means “wedding”. Practical example: ‘ḥaḍarnā al-ʿurs’ (we attended the wedding / حضرنا العرس).

msa-i-151.question: What does the Arabic word عِيد (pronounced ʿīd) mean?
msa-i-151.explanation: عِيد (ʿīd) means “festival” or “Eid”. Practical example: ‘ʿīd mubārak’ (blessed Eid / عيد مبارك).

msa-i-152.question: What does the Arabic word ذِكْرَى (pronounced dhikrā) mean?
msa-i-152.explanation: ذِكْرَى (dhikrā) means “memory” or “anniversary”. Practical example: ‘dhikrā al-istiqlāl’ (Independence Day anniversary / ذكرى الاستقلال).

msa-i-153.question: What does the Arabic word تَارِيخ (pronounced tārīkh) mean?
msa-i-153.explanation: تَارِيخ (tārīkh) means “history” or “date”. Practical example: ‘tārīkhu al-yawm’ (today’s date / تاريخ اليوم).

msa-i-154.question: What does the Arabic word جُغْرَافْيَا (pronounced jughrāfiyā) mean?
msa-i-154.explanation: جُغْرَافْيَا (jughrāfiyā) means “geography”. Practical example: ‘adrusu al-jughrāfiyā’ (I study geography / أدرس الجغرافيا).

msa-i-155.question: What does the Arabic word عُلُوم (pronounced ʿulūm) mean?
msa-i-155.explanation: عُلُوم (ʿulūm) means “sciences”. Practical example: ‘yuḥibbu al-ʿulūm’ (he loves the sciences / يحب العلوم).

msa-i-156.question: What does the Arabic word رِيَاضِيَّات (pronounced riyāḍiyyāt) mean?
msa-i-156.explanation: رِيَاضِيَّات (riyāḍiyyāt) means “mathematics”. Practical example: ‘ar-riyāḍiyyātu ṣaʿbah’ (mathematics is difficult / الرياضيات صعبة).

msa-i-157.question: What does the Arabic word فِيزْيَاء (pronounced fīzyāʾ) mean?
msa-i-157.explanation: فِيزْيَاء (fīzyāʾ) means “physics”. Practical example: ‘yadrusu al-fīzyāʾ’ (he studies physics / يدرس الفيزياء).

msa-i-158.question: What does the Arabic word كِيمْيَاء (pronounced kīmyāʾ) mean?
msa-i-158.explanation: كِيمْيَاء (kīmyāʾ) means “chemistry”. Practical example: ‘tujrā tajāribu fī al-kīmyāʾ’ (experiments are done in chemistry / تجرى تجارب في الكيمياء).

msa-i-159.question: What does the Arabic word أَحْيَاء (pronounced aḥyāʾ) mean?
msa-i-159.explanation: أَحْيَاء (aḥyāʾ) means “biology”. Practical example: ‘tadrusu al-aḥyāʾ’ (she studies biology / تدرس الأحياء).

msa-i-160.question: What does the Arabic word أَدَب (pronounced adab) mean?
msa-i-160.explanation: أَدَب (adab) means “literature”. Practical example: ‘yuḥibbu al-adaba al-ʿarabiyy’ (he loves Arabic literature / يحب الأدب العربي).

msa-i-161.question: What does the Arabic word شِعْر (pronounced shiʿr) mean?
msa-i-161.explanation: شِعْر (shiʿr) means “poetry”. Practical example: ‘kataba shiʿran jamīlan’ (he wrote beautiful poetry / كتب شعراً جميلاً).

msa-i-162.question: What does the Arabic word قِصَّة (pronounced qiṣṣah) mean?
msa-i-162.explanation: قِصَّة (qiṣṣah) means “story”. Practical example: ‘qaraʾtu qiṣṣatan mumtiʿah’ (I read an enjoyable story / قرأت قصة ممتعة).

msa-i-163.question: What does the Arabic word رِوَايَة (pronounced riwāyah) mean?
msa-i-163.explanation: رِوَايَة (riwāyah) means “novel”. Practical example: ‘hādhī riwāyatun mashhūrah’ (this is a famous novel / هذه رواية مشهورة).

msa-i-164.question: What does the Arabic word مَعْنَى (pronounced maʿnā) mean?
msa-i-164.explanation: مَعْنَى (maʿnā) means “meaning”. Practical example: ‘mā maʿnā hādhihi al-kalimah?’ (What is the meaning of this word? / ما معنى هذه الكلمة؟).

msa-i-165.question: What does the Arabic word جُمْلَة (pronounced jumlah) mean?
msa-i-165.explanation: جُمْلَة (jumlah) means “sentence”. Practical example: ‘uktub jumlah ṣaḥīḥah’ (write a correct sentence / اكتب جملة صحيحة).

msa-i-166.question: What does the Arabic word فِقْرَة (pronounced fiqrah) mean?
msa-i-166.explanation: فِقْرَة (fiqrah) means “paragraph”. Practical example: ‘iqraʾ al-fiqrah ath-thāniyah’ (read the second paragraph / اقرأ الفقرة الثانية).

msa-i-167.question: What does the Arabic word فَصْل (pronounced faṣl) mean?
msa-i-167.explanation: فَصْل (faṣl) means “chapter”, “class” or “season”. Practical example: ‘faṣlu ar-rabīʿ’ (the spring season / فصل الربيع).

msa-a-1.question: What does the Arabic word بَيَان صَحَفِيّ (pronounced bayān ṣaḥafī) mean?
msa-a-1.explanation: بَيَان صَحَفِيّ (bayān ṣaḥafī) means “Press release / Statement”. Bayan sahafi (بيان صحفي) is standard media terminology for an official press statement. Practical example: 'Asdarat al-wizarah bayanan sahfiyan yawma al-ithnayn' (The ministry issued a press statement on Monday).

msa-a-2.question: What does the Arabic word رَغْمَ ذَٰلِكَ (pronounced raghma dhālika) mean?
msa-a-2.explanation: رَغْمَ ذَٰلِكَ (raghma dhālika) means “Nevertheless / However”. Raghma dhalika (رغم ذلك) or 'Ala kulli hal means nevertheless / despite that. Practical example: 'Raghma dhalika, al-mashru' najaha najahan sahigan' (Nevertheless, the project achieved roaring success).

msa-a-3.question: What does the Arabic word فِي الْمَطَافِ الْأَخِير (pronounced fī al-maṭāf al-akhīr) mean?
msa-a-3.explanation: فِي الْمَطَافِ الْأَخِير (fī al-maṭāf al-akhīr) means “In the final analysis / ultimately”. Fi al-mataf al-akhir is an idiomatic literary and political expression for 'ultimately'. Practical example: 'Fi al-mataf al-akhir, al-haqqu ya'lu' (Ultimately, truth prevails).

msa-a-4.question: What does the Arabic word عَلَاقَات دِبْلُومَاسِيَّة (pronounced ʿalāqāt diblūmāsiyyah) mean?
options: Out of caution / as a precautionary measure
msa-a-4.explanation: عَلَاقَات دِبْلُومَاسِيَّة (ʿalāqāt diblūmāsiyyah) means “Diplomatic relations”. Alaqat diblumasiyyah (علاقات دبلوماسية) refers to diplomatic relations. Practical example: 'Qata'at al-dawlatan al-alaqat al-diblumasiyyah' (The two countries severed diplomatic relations).

msa-a-5.question: What does the Arabic word التَّنْمِيَةُ الْمُسْتَدَامَة (pronounced at-tanmiyah al-mustadāmah) mean?
msa-a-5.explanation: التَّنْمِيَةُ الْمُسْتَدَامَة (at-tanmiyah al-mustadāmah) means “Sustainable development”. Al-tanmiyah al-mustadamah (التنمية المستدامة) is the standard policy term for sustainable development. Practical example: 'Tas'aa al-duwal li-tahqiq al-tanmiyah al-mustadamah' (Countries strive to achieve sustainable development).

msa-a-6.question: What does the Arabic word مِنْ بَابِ الِاحْتِيَاط (pronounced min bāb al-iḥtiyāṭ) mean?
options: Out of caution / as a precautionary measure
msa-a-6.explanation: مِنْ بَابِ الِاحْتِيَاط (min bāb al-iḥtiyāṭ) means “Out of caution / as a precautionary measure”. Min bab al-ihtiyat is widely used in news, administration, and daily advice. Practical example: 'Akhadna al-mizzata min bab al-ihtiyat' (We took the umbrella as a precaution).

msa-a-7.question: What does the Arabic word الرَّأْيُ الْعَامّ (pronounced ar-raʾy al-ʿāmm) mean?
msa-a-7.explanation: الرَّأْيُ الْعَامّ (ar-raʾy al-ʿāmm) means “Public opinion”. Al-ra'y al-amm (الرأي العام) means public opinion. Practical example: 'Yuta'assaru al-ra'y al-amm bi-wasail al-i'lam' (Public opinion is influenced by mass media).

msa-a-8.question: What does the Arabic word مِنْ جِهَةٍ أُخْرَى (pronounced min jihatin ukhrā) mean?
msa-a-8.explanation: مِنْ جِهَةٍ أُخْرَى (min jihatin ukhrā) means “On the other hand”. Min jihatin ukhra (من جهة أخرى) means on the other hand. Practical example: 'Al-mashru' mufid, wa-min jihatin ukhra yakallifu katheeran' (The project is useful, and on the other hand, it costs a lot).

msa-a-9.question: What does the Arabic word غَيْرُ قَابِلٍ لِلنِّقَاش (pronounced ghayr qābil lin-niqāsh) mean?
msa-a-9.explanation: غَيْرُ قَابِلٍ لِلنِّقَاش (ghayr qābil lin-niqāsh) means “Not open for discussion”. Ghayr qabil lil-niqash (غير قابل للنقاش) means indisputable or non-negotiable. Practical example: 'Hadha mabda'un ghayr qabil lil-niqash' (This is a non-negotiable principle).

msa-a-10.question: What does the Arabic word حُقُوقُ الْإِنْسَان (pronounced ḥuqūq al-insān) mean?
msa-a-10.explanation: حُقُوقُ الْإِنْسَان (ḥuqūq al-insān) means “Human rights”. Huquq al-insan (حقوق الإنسان) means human rights. Practical example: 'Tadfa'u al-munazzamat li-hifz huquq al-insan' (Organizations push to protect human rights).

msa-a-11.question: What does the Arabic word نَتِيجَةً لِذَٰلِكَ (pronounced natījatan li-dhālika) mean?
msa-a-11.explanation: نَتِيجَةً لِذَٰلِكَ (natījatan li-dhālika) means “Consequently / As a result”. Natijatan li-dhalika (نتيجة لذلك) means consequently. Practical example: 'Irtafa'ati al-as'ar, wa-natijatan li-dhalika qalati al-muştariyyat' (Prices rose, and consequently purchases decreased).

msa-a-12.question: What does the Arabic word صِفَة رَسْمِيَّة (pronounced ṣifah rasmiyyah) mean?
msa-a-12.explanation: صِفَة رَسْمِيَّة (ṣifah rasmiyyah) means “Official capacity”. Sifat rasmiyyah denotes official capacity. Practical example: 'Zara al-wazeeru al-madinata bi-sifatin rasmiyyah' (The minister visited the city in an official capacity).

msa-a-13.question: What does the Arabic word السُّلْطَةُ التَّنْفِيذِيَّة (pronounced as-sulṭah at-tanfīdhiyyah) mean?
msa-a-13.explanation: السُّلْطَةُ التَّنْفِيذِيَّة (as-sulṭah at-tanfīdhiyyah) means “Executive authority”. Al-sulta al-tanfeethiyyah (السلطة التنفيذية) is the executive authority. Practical example: 'Taqudu al-sulta al-tanfeethiyyah al-siyasat al-ammah' (The executive branch leads public policy).

msa-a-14.question: What does the Arabic word بِلَا شَكّ (pronounced bilā shakk) mean?
msa-a-14.explanation: بِلَا شَكّ (bilā shakk) means “Without a doubt”. Bila shakk (بلا شك) means without a doubt. Practical example: 'Al-ilmu nurun, bila shakk' (Knowledge is light, without a doubt).

msa-a-15.question: What does the Arabic word عَلَى قَدَمٍ وَسَاق (pronounced ʿalā qadam wa sāq) mean?
msa-a-15.explanation: عَلَى قَدَمٍ وَسَاق (ʿalā qadam wa sāq) means “In full swing”. Ala qadam wasaq is an advanced MSA idiom meaning work is proceeding at full speed. Practical example: 'Al-amal yajri ala qadam wasaq li-injaz al-matar' (Work is proceeding in full swing to complete the airport).

msa-a-16.question: What does the Arabic word الِاقْتِصَادُ الْعَالَمِيّ (pronounced al-iqtiṣād al-ʿālamī) mean?
msa-a-16.explanation: الِاقْتِصَادُ الْعَالَمِيّ (al-iqtiṣād al-ʿālamī) means “Global economy”. Al-iqtisad al-alami (الاقتصاد العالمي) means global economy. Practical example: 'Yata'aththaru al-iqtisad al-mahalli bi-al-iqtisad al-alami' (The local economy is affected by the global economy).

msa-a-17.question: What does the Arabic word فِي ضَوْءِ الظُّرُوفِ الرَّاهِنَة (pronounced fī ḍawʾ aẓ-ẓurūf ar-rāhinah) mean?
msa-a-17.explanation: فِي ضَوْءِ الظُّرُوفِ الرَّاهِنَة (fī ḍawʾ aẓ-ẓurūf ar-rāhinah) means “In light of current circumstances”. Fi daw' al-zuruf al-rahinah (في ضوء الظروف الراهنة) is standard formal phrasing. Practical example: 'Fi daw' al-zuruf al-rahinah, qarrarNa ta'jeel al-mu'tamar' (In light of current circumstances, we decided to postpone the conference).

msa-a-18.question: What does the Arabic word اتِّفَاقِيَّة اِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّة (pronounced ittifāqiyyah istirātījiyyah) mean?
msa-a-18.explanation: اتِّفَاقِيَّة اِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّة (ittifāqiyyah istirātījiyyah) means “Strategic agreement”. Ittifaqiyah istiratijiyyah denotes a strategic agreement. Practical example: 'Waqqa'a al-tarafani ittifaqiyatan istiratijiyyatan' (The two parties signed a strategic agreement).

msa-a-19.question: What does the Arabic word الذَّكَاءُ الِاصْطِنَاعِيّ (pronounced adh-dhakāʾ al-iṣṭināʿī) mean?
msa-a-19.explanation: الذَّكَاءُ الِاصْطِنَاعِيّ (adh-dhakāʾ al-iṣṭināʿī) means “Artificial Intelligence (AI)”. Al-dhaka' al-istisna'i (الذكاء الاصطناعي) is the official MSA term for Artificial Intelligence. Practical example: 'Yadkhalu al-dhaka' al-istisna'i fi kulli majal' (Artificial Intelligence is entering every field).

msa-a-20.question: What does the Arabic word لَعِبَ دَوْرًا مِحْوَرِيًّا (pronounced laʿiba dawran miḥwariyyan) mean?
msa-a-20.explanation: لَعِبَ دَوْرًا مِحْوَرِيًّا (laʿiba dawran miḥwariyyan) means “To play a pivotal role”. Laiiba dawran mahwariyyan (لعب دوراً محورياً) means to play a pivotal role. Practical example: 'Tal'abu al-tarbiyyah dawran mahwariyyan fi bina' al-ajyal' (Education plays a pivotal role in building generations).

msa-a-21.question: What does the Arabic word تَشْكِيلُ الْحُكُومَة (pronounced tashkīl al-ḥukūmah) mean?
msa-a-21.explanation: تَشْكِيلُ الْحُكُومَة (tashkīl al-ḥukūmah) means “Forming the government”. Taskheel al-hukumah (تشكيل الحكومة) refers to cabinet or government formation. Practical example: 'Bada'a al-ra'is taskheel al-hukumah al-jadidah' (The president began forming the new government).

msa-a-22.question: What does the Arabic word الْبُنْيَةُ التَّحْتِيَّة (pronounced al-bunyah at-taḥtiyyah) mean?
msa-a-22.explanation: الْبُنْيَةُ التَّحْتِيَّة (al-bunyah at-taḥtiyyah) means “Infrastructure”. Al-bunya al-tahtiyyah (البنية التحتية) means infrastructure. Practical example: 'Tastathmiru al-daulah fi tahseen al-bunya al-tahtiyyah' (The state invests in improving infrastructure).

msa-a-23.question: What does the Arabic word مَعَ الْأَخْذِ فِي الِاعْتِبَار (pronounced maʿa al-akhdh fī al-iʿtibār) mean?
msa-a-23.explanation: مَعَ الْأَخْذِ فِي الِاعْتِبَار (maʿa al-akhdh fī al-iʿtibār) means “Bearing in mind”. Ma'a al-akhdhi fi al-i'tibar (مع الأخذ في الاعتبار) means taking into consideration. Practical example: 'Yajib al-takhdeedu ma'a al-akhdhi fi al-i'tibar al-takalif' (Planning must be done, taking costs into consideration).

msa-a-24.question: What does the Arabic word وَحْدَةُ الرَّأْي (pronounced waḥdat ar-raʾy) mean?
msa-a-24.explanation: وَحْدَةُ الرَّأْي (waḥdat ar-raʾy) means “Unity of opinion / consensus”. Wihdat al-ra'y means consensus or unity of perspective. Practical example: 'S'aa al-mu'tamar ila tahqiq wihdat al-ra'y' (The conference sought to achieve consensus).

msa-a-25.question: What does the Arabic word مِنْطَقَة تِجَارِيَّة حُرَّة (pronounced minṭaqah tijāriyyah ḥurrah) mean?
msa-a-25.explanation: مِنْطَقَة تِجَارِيَّة حُرَّة (minṭaqah tijāriyyah ḥurrah) means “Free trade zone”. Mintaqah tijariyyah hurrah (منطقة تجارية حرة) means free trade zone. Practical example: 'Unshi'at mintaqah tijariyyah hurrah bayna al-dawlatayn' (A free trade zone was established between the two countries).

msa-a-26.question: What does the Arabic word بِلَا قُيُودٍ أَوْ شُرُوط (pronounced bilā quyūd aw shurūṭ) mean?
msa-a-26.explanation: بِلَا قُيُودٍ أَوْ شُرُوط (bilā quyūd aw shurūṭ) means “Without preconditions”. Bila quyud aw shurut (بلا قيود أو شروط) means without restrictions or conditions. Practical example: 'Da'aw ila hiwarin wataniyyin bila quyud aw shurut' (They called for a national dialogue without preconditions).

msa-a-27.question: What does the Arabic word مُوَاجَهَةُ التَّصَحُّر (pronounced muwājahat at-taṣaḥḥur) mean?
msa-a-27.explanation: مُوَاجَهَةُ التَّصَحُّر (muwājahat at-taṣaḥḥur) means “Combating desertification”. Muwajahat al-tasahhur (مواجهة التصحر) means combating desertification. Practical example: 'Tantafi'u al-hukumah bi-musharoot al-shajar li-muwajahat al-tasahhur' (The government implements tree planting to combat desertification).

msa-a-28.question: What does the Arabic word شَفَّافِيَّة (pronounced shafāfiyyah) mean?
msa-a-28.explanation: شَفَّافِيَّة (shafāfiyyah) means “Transparency”. Shifafiyyah (شفافية) means transparency. Practical example: 'Tatulabu al-sharikatu al-shifafiyyah fi al-maliyyah' (The company demands financial transparency).

msa-a-29.question: What does the Arabic word مِنْ هَٰذَا الْمَنْظُور (pronounced min hādhā al-manẓūr) mean?
msa-a-29.explanation: مِنْ هَٰذَا الْمَنْظُور (min hādhā al-manẓūr) means “From this perspective”. Min hadha al-manzur (من هذا المنظور) means from this perspective. Practical example: 'Min hadha al-manzur, nabda'u tahtil al-mushkilah' (From this perspective, we begin analyzing the problem).

msa-a-30.question: What does the Arabic word تَفَاعُل إِيجَابِيّ (pronounced tafāʿul ījābī) mean?
msa-a-30.explanation: تَفَاعُل إِيجَابِيّ (tafāʿul ījābī) means “Positive interaction”. Tafa'ul ijabi means constructive interaction. Practical example: 'Lada al-iqtirahu tafa'ulan ijabiyan min al-jamhur' (The proposal met with positive engagement from the public).

msa-a-31.question: What does the Arabic word الطَّاقَةُ الْمُتَجَدِّدَة (pronounced aṭ-ṭāqah al-mutajaddidah) mean?
msa-a-31.explanation: الطَّاقَةُ الْمُتَجَدِّدَة (aṭ-ṭāqah al-mutajaddidah) means “Renewable energy”. Al-taqa al-mutajaddidah (الطاقة المتجددة) means renewable energy. Practical example: 'Tattajihu al-alam nahwa istikhdam al-taqa al-mutajaddidah' (The world is moving toward using renewable energy).

msa-a-32.question: What does the Arabic word مِنَ الْجَدِيرِ بِالذِّكْرِ أَنَّ (pronounced min al-jadīr bidh-dhikr anna) mean?
msa-a-32.explanation: مِنَ الْجَدِيرِ بِالذِّكْرِ أَنَّ (min al-jadīr bidh-dhikr anna) means “It is worth noting that...”. Min al-jadire bi-al-dhikr anna (من الجدير بالذكر أن) means it is worth mentioning that. Practical example: 'Min al-jadire bi-al-dhikr anna al-mushru' intaha qabla mawqithi' (It is worth noting that the project finished before its deadline).

msa-a-33.question: What does the Arabic word الْعَرَبِيَّةُ الْفُصْحَى (pronounced al-ʿarabiyyah al-fuṣḥā) mean?
msa-a-33.explanation: الْعَرَبِيَّةُ الْفُصْحَى (al-ʿarabiyyah al-fuṣḥā) means “Bridge dialects, literature & global media”. MSA serves as the unified literary, administrative, and journalistic bridge connecting over 20 nations and millions of Arabic speakers worldwide.

msa-a-34.question: What does the Arabic word دِيمُقْرَاطِيَّة (pronounced dīmuqrāṭiyyah) mean?
msa-a-34.explanation: دِيمُقْرَاطِيَّة (dīmuqrāṭiyyah) means “democracy”. Practical example: ‘tadʿamu ad-dawlatu ad-dīmuqrāṭiyyah’ (the state supports democracy / تدعم الدولة الديمقراطية).

msa-a-35.question: What does the Arabic word اِنْتِخَابَات (pronounced intikhābāt) mean?
msa-a-35.explanation: اِنْتِخَابَات (intikhābāt) means “elections”. Practical example: ‘tajrī al-intikhābāt ghadan’ (elections are held tomorrow / تجري الانتخابات غداً).

msa-a-36.question: What does the Arabic word بَرْلَمَان (pronounced barlamān) mean?
msa-a-36.explanation: بَرْلَمَان (barlamān) means “parliament”. Practical example: ‘iʿtamada al-barlamānu al-qānūn’ (parliament approved the law / اعتمد البرلمان القانون).

msa-a-37.question: What does the Arabic word حُكُومَة (pronounced ḥukūmah) mean?
msa-a-37.explanation: حُكُومَة (ḥukūmah) means “government”. Practical example: ‘ashakalat al-ḥukūmatu al-jadīdah’ (the new government was formed / شكلت الحكومة الجديدة).

msa-a-38.question: What does the Arabic word وِزَارَة (pronounced wizārah) mean?
msa-a-38.explanation: وِزَارَة (wizārah) means “ministry”. Practical example: ‘wizāratu aṣ-ṣiḥḥah’ (the Ministry of Health / وزارة الصحة).

msa-a-39.question: What does the Arabic word دُسْتُور (pronounced dustūr) mean?
msa-a-39.explanation: دُسْتُور (dustūr) means “constitution”. Practical example: ‘yuḥaffiẓu ad-dustūru ḥuqūqa al-muwāṭinīn’ (the constitution protects citizens’ rights / يحفظ الدستور حقوق المواطنين).

msa-a-40.question: What does the Arabic word قَانُون (pronounced qānūn) mean?
msa-a-40.explanation: قَانُون (qānūn) means “law”. Practical example: ‘yajibu al-iltizāmu bil-qānūn’ (one must abide by the law / يجب الالتزام بالقانون).

msa-a-41.question: What does the Arabic word مُعَاهَدَة (pronounced muʿāhadah) mean?
msa-a-41.explanation: مُعَاهَدَة (muʿāhadah) means “treaty”. Practical example: ‘waqqaʿat ad-duwalu al-muʿāhadah’ (the states signed the treaty / وقعت الدول المعاهدة).

msa-a-42.question: What does the Arabic word سِيَادَة (pronounced siyādah) mean?
msa-a-42.explanation: سِيَادَة (siyādah) means “sovereignty”. Practical example: ‘tuḥāfiẓu ad-dawlatu ʿalā siyādatihā’ (the state preserves its sovereignty / تحافظ الدولة على سيادتها).

msa-a-43.question: What does the Arabic word مُوَاطَنَة (pronounced muwāṭanah) mean?
msa-a-43.explanation: مُوَاطَنَة (muwāṭanah) means “citizenship”. Practical example: ‘al-muwāṭanatu ḥaqqun wa wājib’ (citizenship is a right and a duty / المواطنة حق وواجب).

msa-a-44.question: What does the Arabic word اِسْتِثْمَار (pronounced istithmār) mean?
msa-a-44.explanation: اِسْتِثْمَار (istithmār) means “investment”. Practical example: ‘jazaba al-istithmāru al-ajnabiyy’ (foreign investment was attracted / جذب الاستثمار الأجنبي).

msa-a-45.question: What does the Arabic word نُمُوّ اِقْتِصَادِيّ (pronounced numuww iqtiṣādiyy) mean?
msa-a-45.explanation: نُمُوّ اِقْتِصَادِيّ (numuww iqtiṣādiyy) means “economic growth”. Practical example: ‘irtāfaʿa an-numuwwu al-iqtiṣādiyy’ (economic growth rose / ارتفع النمو الاقتصادي).

msa-a-46.question: What does the Arabic word تَضَخُّم (pronounced taḍakhkhum) mean?
msa-a-46.explanation: تَضَخُّم (taḍakhkhum) means “inflation”. Practical example: ‘yanbaghī mukāfaḥatu at-taḍakhkhum’ (inflation must be fought / ينبغي مكافحة التضخم).

msa-a-47.question: What does the Arabic word مِيزَانِيَّة (pronounced mīzāniyyah) mean?
msa-a-47.explanation: مِيزَانِيَّة (mīzāniyyah) means “budget”. Practical example: ‘iʿtamadat al-ḥukūmatu al-mīzāniyyah’ (the government approved the budget / اعتمدت الحكومة الميزانية).

msa-a-48.question: What does the Arabic word ضَرِيبَة (pronounced ḍarībah) mean?
msa-a-48.explanation: ضَرِيبَة (ḍarībah) means “tax”. Practical example: ‘tadfaʿu ash-sharīkatu aḍ-ḍarāʾib’ (the company pays taxes / تدفع الشركة الضرائب).

msa-a-49.question: What does the Arabic word تِجَارَة دَوْلِيَّة (pronounced tijārah dawliyyah) mean?
msa-a-49.explanation: تِجَارَة دَوْلِيَّة (tijārah dawliyyah) means “international trade”. Practical example: ‘tanmū at-tijāratu ad-dawliyyah’ (international trade is growing / تنمو التجارة الدولية).

msa-a-50.question: What does the Arabic word صَادِرَات (pronounced ṣādirāt) mean?
msa-a-50.explanation: صَادِرَات (ṣādirāt) means “exports”. Practical example: ‘izdādat aṣ-ṣādirāt hādhā al-ʿām’ (exports increased this year / ازدادت الصادرات هذا العام).

msa-a-51.question: What does the Arabic word وَارِدَات (pronounced wāridāt) mean?
msa-a-51.explanation: وَارِدَات (wāridāt) means “imports”. Practical example: ‘taqallalat al-wāridāt’ (imports decreased / تقللت الواردات).

msa-a-52.question: What does the Arabic word بَطَالَة (pronounced baṭālah) mean?
msa-a-52.explanation: بَطَالَة (baṭālah) means “unemployment”. Practical example: ‘taqillu nisbatu al-baṭālah’ (the unemployment rate is falling / تقل نسبة البطالة).

msa-a-53.question: What does the Arabic word تَنْمِيَة بَشَرِيَّة (pronounced tanmiyah bashariyyah) mean?
msa-a-53.explanation: تَنْمِيَة بَشَرِيَّة (tanmiyah bashariyyah) means “human development”. Practical example: ‘tuʿtabaru at-tanmiyatu al-bashariyyah awlawiyyah’ (human development is considered a priority / تعتبر التنمية البشرية أولوية).

msa-a-54.question: What does the Arabic word وَسَائِل الْإِعْلَام (pronounced wasāʾil al-iʿlām) mean?
msa-a-54.explanation: وَسَائِل الْإِعْلَام (wasāʾil al-iʿlām) means “mass media”. Practical example: ‘tuʾaththiru wasāʾilu al-iʿlām fī ar-raʾy al-ʿāmm’ (the media influence public opinion / تؤثر وسائل الإعلام في الرأي العام).

msa-a-55.question: What does the Arabic word نَشْرَة أَخْبَار (pronounced nashrat akhbār) mean?
msa-a-55.explanation: نَشْرَة أَخْبَار (nashrat akhbār) means “news bulletin”. Practical example: ‘shāhadtu nashrata al-akhbār’ (I watched the news bulletin / شاهدت نشرة الأخبار).

msa-a-56.question: What does the Arabic word مَقَال (pronounced maqāl) mean?
msa-a-56.explanation: مَقَال (maqāl) means “article”. Practical example: ‘kataba maqālan ʿan at-taghayyur al-munākhī’ (he wrote an article on climate change / كتب مقالاً عن التغير المناخي).

msa-a-57.question: What does the Arabic word مُقَابَلَة (pronounced muqābalah) mean?
msa-a-57.explanation: مُقَابَلَة (muqābalah) means “interview”. Practical example: ‘ajrā muqābalah maʿa al-wazīr’ (he conducted an interview with the minister / أجرى مقابلة مع الوزير).

msa-a-58.question: What does the Arabic word بَثّ مُبَاشِر (pronounced bathth mubāshir) mean?
msa-a-58.explanation: بَثّ مُبَاشِر (bathth mubāshir) means “live broadcast”. Practical example: ‘yubaththu al-ḥadathu mubāshiratan’ (the event is broadcast live / يبث الحدث مباشرة).

msa-a-59.question: What does the Arabic word رَقَابَة (pronounced raqābah) mean?
msa-a-59.explanation: رَقَابَة (raqābah) means “censorship” or “oversight”. Practical example: ‘tufraḍu ar-raqābah ʿalā baʿḍi al-manāshir’ (censorship is imposed on some publications / تفرض الرقابة على بعض المناشير).

msa-a-60.question: What does the Arabic word مِصْدَاقِيَّة (pronounced miṣdāqiyyah) mean?
msa-a-60.explanation: مِصْدَاقِيَّة (miṣdāqiyyah) means “credibility”. Practical example: ‘taʿtamidu al-wasāʾilu ʿalā al-miṣdāqiyyah’ (media rely on credibility / تعتمد الوسائل على المصداقية).

msa-a-61.question: What does the Arabic word تَغْطِيَة إِعْلَامِيَّة (pronounced taghṭiyah iʿlāmiyyah) mean?
msa-a-61.explanation: تَغْطِيَة إِعْلَامِيَّة (taghṭiyah iʿlāmiyyah) means “media coverage”. Practical example: ‘kānat at-taghṭiyatu wāsiʿah’ (the coverage was extensive / كانت التغطية واسعة).

msa-a-62.question: What does the Arabic word رَأْي عَامّ (pronounced raʾy ʿāmm) mean?
msa-a-62.explanation: رَأْي عَامّ (raʾy ʿāmm) means “public opinion”. Practical example: ‘yuʾaththiru al-iʿlāmu fī ar-raʾy al-ʿāmm’ (the media influence public opinion / يؤثر الإعلام في الرأي العام).

msa-a-63.question: What does the Arabic word اِسْتِطْلَاع رَأْي (pronounced istiṭlāʿ raʾy) mean?
msa-a-63.explanation: اِسْتِطْلَاع رَأْي (istiṭlāʿ raʾy) means “opinion poll” or “survey”. Practical example: ‘azhara al-istiṭlāʿu daʿman wāsiʿan’ (the poll showed wide support / أظهر الاستطلاع دعماً واسعاً).

msa-a-64.question: What does the Arabic word تَغَيُّر مُنَاخِيّ (pronounced taghayyur munākhiyy) mean?
msa-a-64.explanation: تَغَيُّر مُنَاخِيّ (taghayyur munākhiyy) means “climate change”. Practical example: ‘yuʿtabaru at-taghayyuru al-munākhiyyu taḥaddiyan ʿālamiyyan’ (climate change is considered a global challenge / يعتبر التغير المناخي تحدياً عالمياً).

msa-a-65.question: What does the Arabic word اِحْتِبَاس حَرَارِيّ (pronounced iḥtibās ḥarāriyy) mean?
msa-a-65.explanation: اِحْتِبَاس حَرَارِيّ (iḥtibās ḥarāriyy) means “global warming”. Practical example: ‘yunādī al-ʿulamāʾu bi-mukāfaḥati al-iḥtibās al-ḥarāriyy’ (scientists call for fighting global warming / ينادي العلماء بمكافحة الاحتباس الحراري).

msa-a-66.question: What does the Arabic word طَاقَة مُتَجَدِّدَة (pronounced ṭāqah mutajaddidah) mean?
msa-a-66.explanation: طَاقَة مُتَجَدِّدَة (ṭāqah mutajaddidah) means “renewable energy”. Practical example: ‘tastathmiru ad-duwalu fī aṭ-ṭāqah al-mutajaddidah’ (states invest in renewable energy / تستثمر الدول في الطاقة المتجددة).

msa-a-67.question: What does the Arabic word اِسْتِدَامَة (pronounced istidāmah) mean?
msa-a-67.explanation: اِسْتِدَامَة (istidāmah) means “sustainability”. Practical example: ‘tatabannā al-mashārīʿu mabdaʾa al-istidāmah’ (projects adopt the principle of sustainability / تتبنى المشاريع مبدأ الاستدامة).

msa-a-68.question: What does the Arabic word تَلَوُّث (pronounced talawwuth) mean?
msa-a-68.explanation: تَلَوُّث (talawwuth) means “pollution”. Practical example: ‘yushakkilu at-talawwuthu khaṭaran ʿalā aṣ-ṣiḥḥah’ (pollution poses a danger to health / يشكل التلوث خطراً على الصحة).

msa-a-69.question: What does the Arabic word بَيْئَة (pronounced bīʾah) mean?
msa-a-69.explanation: بَيْئَة (bīʾah) means “environment”. Practical example: ‘yajibu ḥimāyatu al-bīʾah’ (the environment must be protected / يجب حماية البيئة).

msa-a-70.question: What does the Arabic word تِكْنُولُوجْيَا (pronounced tiknūlūjiyā) mean?
msa-a-70.explanation: تِكْنُولُوجْيَا (tiknūlūjiyā) means “technology”. Practical example: ‘tataṭawwaru at-tiknūlūjiyā bi-surʿah’ (technology develops rapidly / تتطور التكنولوجيا بسرعة).

msa-a-71.question: What does the Arabic word اِبْتِكَار (pronounced ibtikār) mean?
msa-a-71.explanation: اِبْتِكَار (ibtikār) means “innovation”. Practical example: ‘yushajjiʿu al-ibtikāra fī ash-sharikāt’ (innovation is encouraged in companies / يشجع الابتكار في الشركات).

msa-a-72.question: What does the Arabic word بَحْث عِلْمِيّ (pronounced baḥth ʿilmiyy) mean?
msa-a-72.explanation: بَحْث عِلْمِيّ (baḥth ʿilmiyy) means “scientific research”. Practical example: ‘yajrī al-bāḥithūna baḥthan ʿilmiyyan’ (researchers conduct scientific research / يجري الباحثون بحثاً علمياً).

msa-a-73.question: What does the Arabic word اِكْتِشَاف (pronounced iktishāf) mean?
msa-a-73.explanation: اِكْتِشَاف (iktishāf) means “discovery”. Practical example: ‘addā al-iktishāfu ilā taqaddumin kabīr’ (the discovery led to great progress / أدى الاكتشاف إلى تقدم كبير).

msa-a-74.question: What does the Arabic word مُفَاوَضَات (pronounced mufāwaḍāt) mean?
msa-a-74.explanation: مُفَاوَضَات (mufāwaḍāt) means “negotiations”. Practical example: ‘istaʾnafat al-mufāwaḍātu’ (negotiations resumed / استأنفت المفاوضات).

msa-a-75.question: What does the Arabic word قِمَّة (pronounced qimmah) mean?
msa-a-75.explanation: قِمَّة (qimmah) means “summit”. Practical example: ‘ʿuqidat qimmatun ʿarabiyyah’ (an Arab summit was held / عقدت قمة عربية).

msa-a-76.question: What does the Arabic word سِفَارَة (pronounced sifārah) mean?
msa-a-76.explanation: سِفَارَة (sifārah) means “embassy”. Practical example: ‘zurtu as-sifārata al-miṣriyyah’ (I visited the Egyptian embassy / زرت السفارة المصرية).

msa-a-77.question: What does the Arabic word سَفِير (pronounced safīr) mean?
msa-a-77.explanation: سَفِير (safīr) means “ambassador”. Practical example: ‘istaqbala as-safīru al-wafd’ (the ambassador received the delegation / استقبل السفير الوفد).

msa-a-78.question: What does the Arabic word وَفْد (pronounced wafd) mean?
msa-a-78.explanation: وَفْد (wafd) means “delegation”. Practical example: ‘waṣala al-wafdu ar-rasmiyy’ (the official delegation arrived / وصل الوفد الرسمي).

msa-a-79.question: What does the Arabic word تَعَاوُن دَوْلِيّ (pronounced taʿāwun dawliyy) mean?
msa-a-79.explanation: تَعَاوُن دَوْلِيّ (taʿāwun dawliyy) means “international cooperation”. Practical example: ‘yataʿazzazu at-taʿāwunu ad-dawliyy’ (international cooperation is strengthening / يتعزز التعاون الدولي).

msa-a-80.question: What does the Arabic word أَزْمَة (pronounced azmah) mean?
msa-a-80.explanation: أَزْمَة (azmah) means “crisis”. Practical example: ‘tawājahat ad-duwalu azmatan iqtiṣādiyyah’ (states faced an economic crisis / تواجدت الدول أزمة اقتصادية).

msa-a-81.question: What does the Arabic word صِرَاع (pronounced ṣirāʿ) mean?
msa-a-81.explanation: صِرَاع (ṣirāʿ) means “conflict”. Practical example: ‘yajibu ḥallu aṣ-ṣirāʿi silmiyyan’ (the conflict must be resolved peacefully / يجب حل الصراع سلمياً).

msa-a-82.question: What does the Arabic word سَلَام (pronounced salām) mean?
msa-a-82.explanation: سَلَام (salām) means “peace”. Practical example: ‘yasʿā al-ʿālamu ilā as-salām’ (the world strives for peace / يسعى العالم إلى السلام).

msa-a-83.question: What does the Arabic word أَمْن قَوْمِيّ (pronounced amn qawmiyy) mean?
msa-a-83.explanation: أَمْن قَوْمِيّ (amn qawmiyy) means “national security”. Practical example: ‘yuʿtabaru al-amnu al-qawmiyyū awlawiyyatan’ (national security is considered a priority / يعتبر الأمن القومي أولوية).

msa-a-84.question: What does the Arabic word بِالنِّسْبَةِ إِلَى (pronounced bin-nisbati ilā) mean?
msa-a-84.explanation: بِالنِّسْبَةِ إِلَى (bin-nisbati ilā) means “with regard to” or “concerning”. Practical example: ‘bin-nisbati ilā hādhā al-mawḍūʿ…’ (with regard to this topic… / بالنسبة إلى هذا الموضوع…).

msa-a-85.question: What does the Arabic word عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ (pronounced ʿalā ar-raghmi min) mean?
msa-a-85.explanation: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ (ʿalā ar-raghmi min) means “despite” or “in spite of”. Practical example: ‘ʿalā ar-raghmi min aṣ-ṣuʿūbāt, najāḥū’ (despite the difficulties, they succeeded / على الرغم من الصعوبات، نجحوا).

msa-a-86.question: What does the Arabic word بِمُوجِب (pronounced bi-mūjib) mean?
msa-a-86.explanation: بِمُوجِب (bi-mūjib) means “pursuant to” or “in accordance with”. Practical example: ‘bi-mūjibi al-qānūn’ (pursuant to the law / بموجب القانون).

msa-a-87.question: What does the Arabic word فِي إِطَار (pronounced fī iṭār) mean?
msa-a-87.explanation: فِي إِطَار (fī iṭār) means “within the framework of”. Practical example: ‘fī iṭāri at-taʿāwuni ad-dawliyy’ (within the framework of international cooperation / في إطار التعاون الدولي).

msa-a-88.question: What does the Arabic word مِنْ أَجْلِ (pronounced min ajli) mean?
options: For the sake of / In order to
msa-a-88.explanation: مِنْ أَجْلِ (min ajli) means “for the sake of” or “in order to”. Practical example: ‘min ajli taḥqīqi as-salām’ (for the sake of achieving peace / من أجل تحقيق السلام).

msa-a-89.question: What does the Arabic word بِالإِضَافَةِ إِلَى (pronounced bil-iḍāfati ilā) mean?
msa-a-89.explanation: بِالإِضَافَةِ إِلَى (bil-iḍāfati ilā) means “in addition to”. Practical example: ‘bil-iḍāfati ilā dhālika…’ (in addition to that… / بالإضافة إلى ذلك…).

msa-a-90.question: What does the Arabic word نَتِيجَةً لِـ (pronounced natījatan li-) mean?
msa-a-90.explanation: نَتِيجَةً لِـ (natījatan li-) means “as a result of”. Practical example: ‘natījatan li-l-istithmār, namā al-iqtiṣād’ (as a result of investment, the economy grew / نتيجة للاستثمار، نما الاقتصاد).

msa-a-91.question: What does the Arabic word فِي ضَوْءِ (pronounced fī ḍawʾi) mean?
msa-a-91.explanation: فِي ضَوْءِ (fī ḍawʾi) means “in light of”. Practical example: ‘fī ḍawʾi at-taṭawwurāti al-akhīrah’ (in light of recent developments / في ضوء التطورات الأخيرة).

msa-a-92.question: What does the Arabic word عَلَى صَعِيدِ (pronounced ʿalā ṣaʿīdi) mean?
options: At the level of / On the plane of
msa-a-92.explanation: عَلَى صَعِيدِ (ʿalā ṣaʿīdi) means “at the level of”. Practical example: ‘ʿalā ṣaʿīdi al-ʿalāqāti ad-dawliyyah’ (at the level of international relations / على صعيد العلاقات الدولية).

msa-a-93.question: What does the Arabic word بِشَكْلٍ عَامّ (pronounced bi-shaklin ʿāmm) mean?
msa-a-93.explanation: بِشَكْلٍ عَامّ (bi-shaklin ʿāmm) means “in general” or “generally”. Practical example: ‘bi-shaklin ʿāmm, kānat an-natāʾiju ījābiyyah’ (in general, the results were positive / بشكل عام، كانت النتائج إيجابية).

msa-a-94.question: What does the Arabic word اِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّة (pronounced istirātījiyyah) mean?
msa-a-94.explanation: اِسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّة (istirātījiyyah) means “strategy”. Practical example: ‘waḍaʿat ash-sharikatu istirātījiyyatan jadīdah’ (the company set a new strategy / وضعت الشركة استراتيجية جديدة).

msa-a-95.question: What does the Arabic word سِيَاسَة (pronounced siyāsah) mean?
msa-a-95.explanation: سِيَاسَة (siyāsah) means “policy” or “politics”. Practical example: ‘tabannat al-ḥukūmatu siyāsatan jadīdah’ (the government adopted a new policy / تبنت الحكومة سياسة جديدة).

msa-a-96.question: What does the Arabic word أَوْلَوِيَّة (pronounced awlawiyyah) mean?
msa-a-96.explanation: أَوْلَوِيَّة (awlawiyyah) means “priority”. Practical example: ‘tuʿtabaru aṣ-ṣiḥḥatu awlawiyyah’ (health is considered a priority / تعتبر الصحة أولوية).

msa-a-97.question: What does the Arabic word تَحَدٍّ (pronounced taḥaddin) mean?
msa-a-97.explanation: تَحَدٍّ (taḥaddin) means “challenge”. Practical example: ‘nuwājihu taḥaddiyātin kabīrah’ (we face great challenges / نواجه تحديات كبيرة).

msa-a-98.question: What does the Arabic word فُرْصَة (pronounced furṣah) mean?
msa-a-98.explanation: فُرْصَة (furṣah) means “opportunity”. Practical example: ‘hādhihi furṣatun thāminah’ (this is a valuable opportunity / هذه فرصة ثمينة).

msa-a-99.question: What does the Arabic word مُبَادَرَة (pronounced mubādarah) mean?
msa-a-99.explanation: مُبَادَرَة (mubādarah) means “initiative”. Practical example: ‘aṭlaqat al-ḥukūmatu mubādaratan’ (the government launched an initiative / أطلقت الحكومة مبادرة).

msa-a-100.question: What does the Arabic word إِصْلَاح (pronounced iṣlāḥ) mean?
msa-a-100.explanation: إِصْلَاح (iṣlāḥ) means “reform”. Practical example: ‘yuṭālabu bil-iṣlāḥi ash-shāmil’ (comprehensive reform is demanded / يطالب بالإصلاح الشامل).

msa-a-101.question: What does the Arabic word تَطْوِير (pronounced taṭwīr) mean?
msa-a-101.explanation: تَطْوِير (taṭwīr) means “development” or “upgrading”. Practical example: ‘yataṭallabu al-mashrūʿu taṭwīran mustamirrān’ (the project requires continuous development / يتطلب المشروع تطويراً مستمراً).

msa-a-102.question: What does the Arabic word تَقَدُّم (pronounced taqaddum) mean?
msa-a-102.explanation: تَقَدُّم (taqaddum) means “progress”. Practical example: ‘ḥaqqaqa al-baladu taqadduman malḥūẓan’ (the country achieved notable progress / حقق البلد تقدماً ملحوظاً).

msa-a-103.question: What does the Arabic word نَجَاح (pronounced najāḥ) mean?
msa-a-103.explanation: نَجَاح (najāḥ) means “success”. Practical example: ‘yuʿtabaru an-najāḥu natījata al-juhd’ (success is considered the result of effort / يعتبر النجاح نتيجة الجهد).

msa-a-104.question: What does the Arabic word أَكَّدَ (pronounced akkada) mean?
msa-a-104.explanation: أَكَّدَ (akkada) means “he confirmed” or “stressed”. Practical example: ‘akkada al-wazīru ahammiyyata al-mashrūʿ’ (the minister stressed the importance of the project / أكد الوزير أهمية المشروع).

msa-a-105.question: What does the Arabic word أَشَارَ إِلَى (pronounced ashāra ilā) mean?
msa-a-105.explanation: أَشَارَ إِلَى (ashāra ilā) means “he pointed out” or “referred to”. Practical example: ‘ashāra ilā aḍ-ḍarūrati al-mulaḥḥah’ (he pointed to the urgent necessity / أشار إلى الضرورة الملحة).

msa-a-106.question: What does the Arabic word أَعْلَنَ (pronounced aʿlana) mean?
msa-a-106.explanation: أَعْلَنَ (aʿlana) means “he announced”. Practical example: ‘aʿlana al-raʾīsu al-qarār’ (the president announced the decision / أعلن الرئيس القرار).

msa-a-107.question: What does the Arabic word طَالَبَ بِـ (pronounced ṭālaba bi-) mean?
msa-a-107.explanation: طَالَبَ بِـ (ṭālaba bi-) means “he demanded” or “called for”. Practical example: ‘ṭālaba bil-iṣlāḥ’ (he called for reform / طالب بالإصلاح).

msa-a-108.question: What does the Arabic word رَفَضَ (pronounced rafaḍa) mean?
msa-a-108.explanation: رَفَضَ (rafaḍa) means “he rejected”. Practical example: ‘rafaḍa al-iqtirāḥ’ (he rejected the proposal / رفض الاقتراح).

msa-a-109.question: What does the Arabic word وَافَقَ عَلَى (pronounced wāfaqa ʿalā) mean?
msa-a-109.explanation: وَافَقَ عَلَى (wāfaqa ʿalā) means “he agreed to”. Practical example: ‘wāfaqa ʿalā al-ittifāqiyyah’ (he agreed to the agreement / وافق على الاتفاقية).

msa-a-110.question: What does the Arabic word نَاقَشَ (pronounced nāqasha) mean?
msa-a-110.explanation: نَاقَشَ (nāqasha) means “he discussed”. Practical example: ‘nāqasha al-majlisu al-qaḍiyyah’ (the council discussed the issue / ناقش المجلس القضية).

msa-a-111.question: What does the Arabic word اِقْتَرَحَ (pronounced iqtaraḥa) mean?
msa-a-111.explanation: اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa) means “he proposed” or “suggested”. Practical example: ‘iqtaraḥa ḥallan jadīdan’ (he proposed a new solution / اقترح حلاً جديداً).

msa-a-112.question: What does the Arabic word أَصْدَرَ (pronounced aṣdara) mean?
msa-a-112.explanation: أَصْدَرَ (aṣdara) means “he issued”. Practical example: ‘aṣdara al-maḥkamatū ḥukman’ (the court issued a ruling / أصدرت المحكمة حكماً).

msa-a-113.question: What does the Arabic word نَفَّذَ (pronounced naffadha) mean?
msa-a-113.explanation: نَفَّذَ (naffadha) means “he implemented” or “executed”. Practical example: ‘naffadhat al-ḥukūmatu al-khuṭṭah’ (the government implemented the plan / نفذت الحكومة الخطة).

msa-a-114.question: What does the Arabic word رَاقَبَ (pronounced rāqaba) mean?
msa-a-114.explanation: رَاقَبَ (rāqaba) means “he monitored” or “supervised”. Practical example: ‘rāqaba al-mashrūʿa ʿan kathab’ (he closely monitored the project / راقب المشروع عن كثب).

msa-a-115.question: What does the Arabic word سَاهَمَ فِي (pronounced sāhama fī) mean?
msa-a-115.explanation: سَاهَمَ فِي (sāhama fī) means “he contributed to”. Practical example: ‘sāhama fī an-najāḥ’ (he contributed to the success / ساهم في النجاح).

msa-a-116.question: What does the Arabic word أَدَّى إِلَى (pronounced addā ilā) mean?
msa-a-116.explanation: أَدَّى إِلَى (addā ilā) means “it led to” or “resulted in”. Practical example: ‘addā al-istithmāru ilā numuwwin’ (investment led to growth / أدى الاستثمار إلى نمو).

msa-a-117.question: What does the Arabic word تَمَثَّلَ فِي (pronounced tamaththala fī) mean?
options: It consisted of / was represented in
msa-a-117.explanation: تَمَثَّلَ فِي (tamaththala fī) means “it consisted of” or “was represented in”. Practical example: ‘tamaththala at-taḥaddī fī naqṣi al-mawārid’ (the challenge consisted in the lack of resources / تمثل التحدي في نقص الموارد).

msa-a-118.question: What does the Arabic word يُعْتَبَرُ (pronounced yuʿtabaru) mean?
msa-a-118.explanation: يُعْتَبَرُ (yuʿtabaru) means “it is considered”. Practical example: ‘yuʿtabaru hādhā taqadduman kabīran’ (this is considered great progress / يعتبر هذا تقدماً كبيراً).

msa-a-119.question: What does the Arabic word يَنْبَغِي (pronounced yanbaghī) mean?
options: It is necessary / one ought to
msa-a-119.explanation: يَنْبَغِي (yanbaghī) means “it is necessary” or “one ought to”. Practical example: ‘yanbaghī al-ʿamalu bi-jidd’ (one ought to work hard / ينبغي العمل بجد).

msa-a-120.question: What does the Arabic word لَا بُدَّ مِنْ (pronounced lā budda min) mean?
options: It is inevitable / there must be
msa-a-120.explanation: لَا بُدَّ مِنْ (lā budda min) means “it is inevitable” or “there must be”. Practical example: ‘lā budda min at-taʿāwun’ (cooperation is inevitable / لا بد من التعاون).

msa-a-121.question: What does the Arabic word مِنَ الْمُمْكِنِ (pronounced min al-mumkini) mean?
msa-a-121.explanation: مِنَ الْمُمْكِنِ (min al-mumkini) means “it is possible”. Practical example: ‘min al-mumkini taḥqīqu al-hadaf’ (it is possible to achieve the goal / من الممكن تحقيق الهدف).

msa-a-122.question: What does the Arabic word مِنَ الضَّرُورِيِّ (pronounced min aḍ-ḍarūriyy) mean?
msa-a-122.explanation: مِنَ الضَّرُورِيِّ (min aḍ-ḍarūriyy) means “it is necessary” or “essential”. Practical example: ‘min aḍ-ḍarūriyy ḥimāyatu al-bīʾah’ (protecting the environment is essential / من الضروري حماية البيئة).

msa-a-123.question: What does the Arabic word فِي الْوَاقِع (pronounced fī al-wāqiʿ) mean?
msa-a-123.explanation: فِي الْوَاقِع (fī al-wāqiʿ) means “in reality” or “actually”. Practical example: ‘fī al-wāqiʿ, kānat an-natījah mukhtalifah’ (in reality, the result was different / في الواقع، كانت النتيجة مختلفة).

msa-a-124.question: What does the Arabic word عَلَى كُلِّ حَال (pronounced ʿalā kulli ḥāl) mean?
options: In any case / At any rate
msa-a-124.explanation: عَلَى كُلِّ حَال (ʿalā kulli ḥāl) means “in any case” or “at any rate”. Practical example: ‘ʿalā kulli ḥāl, yajibu al-muḍī’ (in any case, we must proceed / على كل حال، يجب المضي).

msa-a-125.question: What does the Arabic word مُجْتَمَع (pronounced mujtamaʿ) mean?
msa-a-125.explanation: مُجْتَمَع (mujtamaʿ) means “society”. Practical example: ‘yataṭawwaru al-mujtamaʿu bi-surʿah’ (society develops rapidly / يتطور المجتمع بسرعة).

msa-a-126.question: What does the Arabic word ثَقَافَة (pronounced thaqāfah) mean?
msa-a-126.explanation: ثَقَافَة (thaqāfah) means “culture”. Practical example: ‘ath-thaqāfatu al-ʿarabiyyah ghaniyyah’ (Arab culture is rich / الثقافة العربية غنية).

msa-a-127.question: What does the Arabic word حَضَارَة (pronounced ḥaḍārah) mean?
msa-a-127.explanation: حَضَارَة (ḥaḍārah) means “civilisation”. Practical example: ‘al-ḥaḍāratu al-islāmiyyah’ (Islamic civilisation / الحضارة الإسلامية).

msa-a-128.question: What does the Arabic word تُرَاث (pronounced turāth) mean?
msa-a-128.explanation: تُرَاث (turāth) means “heritage”. Practical example: ‘yuḥāfaẓu ʿalā at-turāth’ (heritage is preserved / يحافظ على التراث).

msa-a-129.question: What does the Arabic word هُوِيَّة (pronounced huwiyyah) mean?
msa-a-129.explanation: هُوِيَّة (huwiyyah) means “identity”. Practical example: ‘al-huwiyyatu ath-thaqāfiyyah’ (cultural identity / الهوية الثقافية).

msa-a-130.question: What does the Arabic word تَنَوُّع (pronounced tanawwuʿ) mean?
msa-a-130.explanation: تَنَوُّع (tanawwuʿ) means “diversity”. Practical example: ‘at-tanawwuʿu ath-thaqāfiyyu ghinan’ (cultural diversity is a richness / التنوع الثقافي غنى).

msa-a-131.question: What does the Arabic word حِوَار (pronounced ḥiwār) mean?
msa-a-131.explanation: حِوَار (ḥiwār) means “dialogue”. Practical example: ‘yajibu taʿzīzu al-ḥiwār’ (dialogue must be strengthened / يجب تعزيز الحوار).

msa-a-132.question: What does the Arabic word تَفَاهُم (pronounced tafāhum) mean?
msa-a-132.explanation: تَفَاهُم (tafāhum) means “mutual understanding”. Practical example: ‘yuʾaddī at-tafāhumu ilā as-salām’ (mutual understanding leads to peace / يؤدي التفاهم إلى السلام).

msa-a-133.question: What does the Arabic word تَسَامُح (pronounced tasāmuḥ) mean?
msa-a-133.explanation: تَسَامُح (tasāmuḥ) means “tolerance”. Practical example: ‘at-tasāmuḥu qīmatun insāniyyah’ (tolerance is a human value / التسامح قيمة إنسانية).

msa-a-134.question: What does the Arabic word عَدَالَة اِجْتِمَاعِيَّة (pronounced ʿadālah ijtimāʿiyyah) mean?
msa-a-134.explanation: عَدَالَة اِجْتِمَاعِيَّة (ʿadālah ijtimāʿiyyah) means “social justice”. Practical example: ‘tuṭālabu bil-ʿadālah al-ijtimāʿiyyah’ (social justice is demanded / تطالب بالعدالة الاجتماعية).

msa-a-135.question: What does the Arabic word مُسَاوَاة (pronounced musāwāh) mean?
msa-a-135.explanation: مُسَاوَاة (musāwāh) means “equality”. Practical example: ‘al-musāwātu bayna al-jinsayn’ (equality between the sexes / المساواة بين الجنسين).

msa-a-136.question: What does the Arabic word تَمْكِين (pronounced tamkīn) mean?
msa-a-136.explanation: تَمْكِين (tamkīn) means “empowerment”. Practical example: ‘tamkīnu al-marʾah’ (women’s empowerment / تمكين المرأة).

msa-a-137.question: What does the Arabic word تَنْمِيَة مُسْتَدَامَة (pronounced tanmiyah mustadāmah) mean?
msa-a-137.explanation: تَنْمِيَة مُسْتَدَامَة (tanmiyah mustadāmah) means “sustainable development”. Practical example: ‘tusaʿā ad-duwalu ilā at-tanmiyah al-mustadāmah’ (states strive for sustainable development / تسعى الدول إلى التنمية المستدامة).

msa-a-138.question: What does the Arabic word مَسْؤُولِيَّة اِجْتِمَاعِيَّة (pronounced masʾūliyyah ijtimāʿiyyah) mean?
msa-a-138.explanation: مَسْؤُولِيَّة اِجْتِمَاعِيَّة (masʾūliyyah ijtimāʿiyyah) means “social responsibility”. Practical example: ‘tataḥammalu ash-sharikātu al-masʾūliyyata al-ijtimāʿiyyah’ (companies bear social responsibility / تتحمل الشركات المسؤولية الاجتماعية).

msa-a-139.question: What does the Arabic word حَوْكَمَة (pronounced ḥawkamah) mean?
msa-a-139.explanation: حَوْكَمَة (ḥawkamah) means “governance”. Practical example: ‘tuʿazzizu al-ḥawkamatu ar-rashīdah ath-thiqah’ (good governance strengthens trust / تعزز الحوكمة الرشيدة الثقة).

msa-a-140.question: What does the Arabic word شَفَافِيَّة (pronounced shafāfiyyah) mean?
msa-a-140.explanation: شَفَافِيَّة (shafāfiyyah) means “transparency”. Practical example: ‘tataṭallabu al-ḥawkamatu ash-shafāfiyyah’ (governance requires transparency / تتطلب الحوكمة الشفافية).

msa-a-141.question: What does the Arabic word مُحَاسَبَة (pronounced muḥāsabah) mean?
msa-a-141.explanation: مُحَاسَبَة (muḥāsabah) means “accountability”. Practical example: ‘lā ḥawkamata bi-dūni muḥāsabah’ (there is no governance without accountability / لا حوكمة بدون محاسبة).

msa-a-142.question: What does the Arabic word نَزَاهَة (pronounced nazāhah) mean?
msa-a-142.explanation: نَزَاهَة (nazāhah) means “integrity”. Practical example: ‘an-nazāhatu min ṣifāti al-qāʾid’ (integrity is among the qualities of a leader / النزاهة من صفات القائد).

msa-a-143.question: What does the Arabic word فَسَاد (pronounced fasād) mean?
msa-a-143.explanation: فَسَاد (fasād) means “corruption”. Practical example: ‘yajibu mukāfaḥatu al-fasād’ (corruption must be fought / يجب مكافحة الفساد).

msa-a-144.question: What does the Arabic word إِصْلَاحَات (pronounced iṣlāḥāt) mean?
msa-a-144.explanation: إِصْلَاحَات (iṣlāḥāt) means “reforms”. Practical example: ‘nuqqiẓat iṣlāḥātun iqtiṣādiyyah’ (economic reforms were implemented / نفذت إصلاحات اقتصادية).

msa-a-145.question: What does the Arabic word تَشْرِيع (pronounced tashrīʿ) mean?
msa-a-145.explanation: تَشْرِيع (tashrīʿ) means “legislation”. Practical example: ‘aṣdara al-barlamānu tashrīʿan jadīdan’ (parliament issued new legislation / أصدر البرلمان تشريعاً جديداً).

msa-a-146.question: What does the Arabic word قَضَاء (pronounced qaḍāʾ) mean?
msa-a-146.explanation: قَضَاء (qaḍāʾ) means “judiciary”. Practical example: ‘al-qaḍāʾu mustaqill’ (the judiciary is independent / القضاء مستقل).

msa-a-147.question: What does the Arabic word حُكْم (pronounced ḥukm) mean?
msa-a-147.explanation: حُكْم (ḥukm) means “ruling”, “judgment” or “rule”. Practical example: ‘aṣdarati al-maḥkamatū ḥukman’ (the court issued a ruling / أصدرت المحكمة حكماً).

msa-a-148.question: What does the Arabic word اِسْتِئْنَاف (pronounced istiʾnāf) mean?
msa-a-148.explanation: اِسْتِئْنَاف (istiʾnāf) means “appeal”. Practical example: ‘qaddama istiʾnāfan’ (he filed an appeal / قدم استئنافاً).

msa-a-149.question: What does the Arabic word اِتِّفَاقِيَّة (pronounced ittifāqiyyah) mean?
msa-a-149.explanation: اِتِّفَاقِيَّة (ittifāqiyyah) means “agreement” or “convention”. Practical example: ‘waqqaʿat ad-duwalu al-ittifāqiyyah’ (the states signed the agreement / وقعت الدول الاتفاقية).

msa-a-150.question: What does the Arabic word بُرُوتُوكُول (pronounced burūtūkūl) mean?
msa-a-150.explanation: بُرُوتُوكُول (burūtūkūl) means “protocol”. Practical example: ‘ittabaʿū al-burūtūkūl ar-rasmiyy’ (they followed the official protocol / اتبعوا البروتوكول الرسمي).

msa-a-151.question: What does the Arabic word مَنْظَّمَة (pronounced munaẓẓamah) mean?
msa-a-151.explanation: مَنْظَّمَة (munaẓẓamah) means “organisation”. Practical example: ‘al-munaẓẓamatu ad-dawliyyah’ (the international organisation / المنظمة الدولية).

msa-a-152.question: What does the Arabic word مُؤَسَّسَة (pronounced muʾassasah) mean?
msa-a-152.explanation: مُؤَسَّسَة (muʾassasah) means “institution” or “foundation”. Practical example: ‘muʾassasatun taʿlīmiyyah’ (an educational institution / مؤسسة تعليمية).

msa-a-153.question: What does the Arabic word هَيْئَة (pronounced hayʾah) mean?
msa-a-153.explanation: هَيْئَة (hayʾah) means “body”, “authority” or “board”. Practical example: ‘hayʾatu al-umam al-muttaḥidah’ (the United Nations body / هيئة الأمم المتحدة).

msa-a-154.question: What does the Arabic word لَجْنَة (pronounced lajnah) mean?
msa-a-154.explanation: لَجْنَة (lajnah) means “committee”. Practical example: ‘shakkalt al-lajnahu’ (the committee was formed / شكلت اللجنة).

msa-a-155.question: What does the Arabic word مَجْلِس (pronounced majlis) mean?
msa-a-155.explanation: مَجْلِس (majlis) means “council” or “assembly”. Practical example: ‘majlisu al-amn’ (the Security Council / مجلس الأمن).

msa-a-156.question: What does the Arabic word قَرَار (pronounced qarār) mean?
msa-a-156.explanation: قَرَار (qarār) means “decision” or “resolution”. Practical example: ‘ittakhadha qarāran hāmman’ (he took an important decision / اتخذ قراراً هاماً).

msa-a-157.question: What does the Arabic word تَوْصِيَة (pronounced tawṣiyah) mean?
msa-a-157.explanation: تَوْصِيَة (tawṣiyah) means “recommendation”. Practical example: ‘qaddamat al-lajnahu tawṣiyātin’ (the committee presented recommendations / قدمت اللجنة توصيات).

msa-a-158.question: What does the Arabic word تَقْرِير (pronounced taqrīr) mean?
msa-a-158.explanation: تَقْرِير (taqrīr) means “report”. Practical example: ‘qaraʾtu at-taqrīr’ (I read the report / قرأت التقرير).

msa-a-159.question: What does the Arabic word بَيَان (pronounced bayān) mean?
msa-a-159.explanation: بَيَان (bayān) means “statement” or “declaration”. Practical example: ‘aṣdarat al-ḥukūmatu bayānan’ (the government issued a statement / أصدرت الحكومة بياناً).

msa-a-160.question: What does the Arabic word خُطَّة (pronounced khuṭṭah) mean?
msa-a-160.explanation: خُطَّة (khuṭṭah) means “plan”. Practical example: ‘waḍaʿū khuṭṭatan shāmilah’ (they drew up a comprehensive plan / وضعوا خطة شاملة).

msa-a-161.question: What does the Arabic word بَرْنَامَج (pronounced barnāmaj) mean?
msa-a-161.explanation: بَرْنَامَج (barnāmaj) means “program” or “programme”. Practical example: ‘barnāmaj at-tanmiyah’ (the development programme / برنامج التنمية).

msa-a-162.question: What does the Arabic word مَشْرُوع (pronounced mashrūʿ) mean?
msa-a-162.explanation: مَشْرُوع (mashrūʿ) means “project”. Practical example: ‘yuʿtabaru al-mashrūʿu istirātījiyyan’ (the project is considered strategic / يعتبر المشروع استراتيجياً).

msa-a-163.question: What does the Arabic word تَنْفِيذ (pronounced tanfīdh) mean?
msa-a-163.explanation: تَنْفِيذ (tanfīdh) means “implementation” or “execution”. Practical example: ‘badaʾa tanfīdhu al-khuṭṭah’ (implementation of the plan began / بدأ تنفيذ الخطة).

msa-a-164.question: What does the Arabic word تَقْيِيم (pronounced taqyīm) mean?
msa-a-164.explanation: تَقْيِيم (taqyīm) means “evaluation” or “assessment”. Practical example: ‘yajrī taqyīmu an-natāʾij’ (results are being evaluated / يجري تقييم النتائج).

msa-a-165.question: What does the Arabic word نَتِيجَة (pronounced natījah) mean?
msa-a-165.explanation: نَتِيجَة (natījah) means “result” or “outcome”. Practical example: ‘kānat an-natījatu ījābiyyah’ (the result was positive / كانت النتيجة إيجابية).

msa-a-166.question: What does the Arabic word أَثَر (pronounced athar) mean?
msa-a-166.explanation: أَثَر (athar) means “impact”, “effect” or “trace”. Practical example: ‘kāna lil-mashrūʿi atharun ījābiyy’ (the project had a positive impact / كان للمشروع أثر إيجابي).
